The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

CODE AMENDMENT 228 APPLICANT: CITY OF AZUSA
LOCATION: CITYWIDE
A City initiated request to amend various sections of Chapter 88, "Development Code, March 2005" (2005 Code) of the City of Azusa Municipal Code. The proposed amendments involve minor adjustments, including but not limited to: allowable land uses, development standards, outdoor storage, nonconforming uses, definitions, and Section 88.080 to comply with the requirements of State AB 1881.
